title: Comparative phrases and clauses
summary: Сравнительные обороты и придаточные: **as ... as**, **twice as ... as**, **the same as**, **than I expected**, **the more..., the more...**, **more and more**, **not so much ... as**.
ru:
## as ... as: равенство, неравенство, кратность
Конструкция **as + прилагательное/наречие + as** выражает равенство; для неравенства используют **not as ... as** (формально и в BrE — также **not so ... as**). Кратность строим цифрой и словами **as ... as** или прямым **times the size of**.
> The report is **as long as** the previous one. — Отчёт такой же длины, как предыдущий.
> It **wasn't as/so cold as** I'd feared. — Было не так холодно, как я боялся.
> Their flat is **twice as big as** ours. = **twice the size of** ours. — Их квартира вдвое больше нашей.
> She earns **three times as much as** I do. — Она зарабатывает втрое больше меня.
- ~~twice bigger than~~ → twice **as big as** (но допустимо **twice the size of**)
- ~~as big than~~ → as big **as**
- ~~the same than~~ → **the same as**

## than-придаточные: что пропускать и что нет
После **than** и **as** глагол часто опускается; нужна лишь форма, которая показывает, что это придаточное. В формальном стиле — **than I (am)**, в разговорной — **than me**.
> He is taller **than I am** / **than I** (formal) / **than me** (informal).
> It was harder **than we expected**. — Было труднее, чем мы ожидали.
> The meeting lasted longer **than necessary / than usual / than planned**. — Совещание длилось дольше, чем нужно / обычно / планировалось.
> Prices are higher **than they used to be**. — Цены выше, чем раньше.
Если придаточное можно сократить, его сокращают: ~~than it was expected~~ → **than expected**.

## the + comparative, the + comparative
Параллельная конструкция выражает «чем..., тем...». Подлежащее и глагол в каждой части идут **после** сравнительной степени, перед ней — **the**.
> **The more** I read, **the less** I understand. — Чем больше читаю, тем меньше понимаю.
> **The sooner** we start, **the better**. — Чем раньше, тем лучше.
> **The higher** the price, **the fewer** customers we have.
В краткой форме глагол опускается: *The sooner, the better.* *The bigger, the better.*

## Нарастающее изменение: more and more
Двойное сравнение через **and** показывает постоянное усиление. Для коротких слов повторяем форму, для длинных — **more and more**.
> Things are getting **worse and worse**. — Дела становятся всё хуже.
> The text became **more and more** complicated. — Текст становился всё сложнее.
> **Fewer and fewer** people use cash. — Всё меньше людей пользуются наличными.

## Другие обороты
- **not so much ... as**: *He is not so much lazy as tired.* — Он не столько ленив, сколько устал.
- **rather than** + глагол/существительное: *I'd walk rather than wait.*
- **as ... as possible / as you can**: *Come as soon as possible.*
- **as many as / as much as** — «целых»: *as many as 300 people came.*
- **no more than / not more than**: no more than ten (всего лишь десять) / not more than ten (максимум десять).
- **the same ... as**: *the same price as*; **different from**; **like** + сущ., **as** + клауза: *like a doctor / as I said*.
en:
## as ... as: equality, inequality, multiples
**as + adjective/adverb + as** shows equality; for inequality use **not as ... as** (also **not so ... as** in formal and British English). Multiples use a number with **as ... as**, or **times the size of**.
> The report is **as long as** the previous one.
> It **wasn't as/so cold as** I'd feared.
> Their flat is **twice as big as** ours. = **twice the size of** ours.
> She earns **three times as much as** I do.
- ~~twice bigger than~~ → twice **as big as** (but **twice the size of** is also possible)
- ~~as big than~~ → as big **as**
- ~~the same than~~ → **the same as**

## than-clauses: what can be left out
After **than** and **as** the verb is often omitted. In formal English we say **than I (am)**, in informal **than me**.
> He is taller **than I am** / **than I** (formal) / **than me** (informal).
> It was harder **than we expected**.
> The meeting lasted longer **than necessary / than usual / than planned**.
> Prices are higher **than they used to be**.
If the clause can be shortened, it usually is: ~~than it was expected~~ → **than expected**.

## the + comparative, the + comparative
This parallel structure means 'as X increases, Y changes'. In each part the subject and verb follow the comparative, and **the** comes before it.
> **The more** I read, **the less** I understand.
> **The sooner** we start, **the better**.
> **The higher** the price, **the fewer** customers we have.
In short form the verb is dropped: *The sooner, the better.* *The bigger, the better.*

## Continuing change: more and more
A doubled comparative with **and** shows a steady increase. Short words are repeated; long words use **more and more**.
> Things are getting **worse and worse**.
> The text became **more and more** complicated.
> **Fewer and fewer** people use cash.

## Other expressions
- **not so much ... as**: *He is not so much lazy as tired.*
- **rather than** + verb/noun: *I'd walk rather than wait.*
- **as ... as possible / as you can**: *Come as soon as possible.*
- **as many as / as much as** — as high a number as: *as many as 300 people came.*
- **no more than / not more than**: no more than ten (only ten) / not more than ten (ten at most).
- **the same ... as**: *the same price as*; **different from**; **like** + noun, **as** + clause: *like a doctor / as I said*.
structure:
## Формулы
> **as** + adj/adv + **as**: as **fast as** possible
> **not as / not so** + adj + **as**: not **as/so** easy **as**
> **twice / half / three times** + **as** + adj/adv + **as**: **twice as** long **as**
> **twice / three times** + **the** + noun + **of**: **twice the length of**
> comparative + **than** + клауза: harder **than I thought**
> **The** + comparative + (подлежащее + глагол), **the** + comparative + (...)
> comparative + **and** + comparative: **colder and colder**; **more and more** + adj

## Таблица: оборот → значение → пример
| Оборот | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| **as ... as** | равенство | as **tall as** her father |
| **not so much ... as** | скорее ... чем | not so much **angry as** upset |
| **than usual / than expected** | сравнение с нормой | **later than usual** |
| **the more..., the more...** | взаимосвязь | **The older** I get, **the wiser** I feel. |
| **more and more** | нарастание | **more and more** people |
| **as many as** | целых | **as many as** 40 |
| **no more than** | всего лишь | **no more than** 20 |

items.text: The film was not nearly {{as|so}} good as the book.
This year's budget is twice {{as}} large as last year's.
She earns three times {{as}} much as I do.
The lecture was longer {{than}} we had anticipated.
The more you practise, {{the}} better you become.
He didn't so much dislike the idea {{as}} distrust the people behind it.
Take {{as}} many copies as you need.
I'd rather walk {{than}} wait for a taxi in this rain.

exercises.title: The more..., the more...
exercises.instruction: Поставьте слова из скобок в нужную форму сравнения.

items.text: The {{more}} I read about the case, the {{less}} I understood.
The {{harder}} you train, the {{better}} you'll perform.
The {{longer}} the delay, the {{angrier|more angry}} the passengers became.
Traffic is getting {{heavier}} and {{heavier}} every year.
Demand is becoming {{more}} and {{more}} difficult to predict.
You asked when we should finish: well, the {{sooner}} the {{better}}.
It took {{longer}} than we expected to get a visa.

items.q: The new office is twice ___ the old one.

items.why: **the same as** — с артиклем и as.

items.q: This phone is different ___ the one I had.
Prices are ___ than they used to be.
items.why: Усилитель **much** + сравнительная степень; more higher — двойное сравнение.

items.q: It's not ___ expensive as I thought.
I'd prefer to stay at home ___ go out in this weather.
The ___ the room, the more furniture you need.
items.why: В конструкции the ... the ... — сравнительная степень.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя сравнительные обороты.

items.prompt: Write about something that is getting more and more expensive or difficult.
items.sample: Renting a flat in my city is getting more and more expensive.

items.prompt: Complete: The more I ..., the more I ...
items.sample: The more I practise, the more confident I feel.

items.prompt: Compare yourself now with five years ago (than I used to be).
items.sample: I'm much more patient than I used to be.

items.prompt: Describe something that was easier or harder than you had expected.
items.sample: Learning to drive was much harder than I had expected.
